india.one_line: Courts penalize AI errors and library fraud as healthcare and payments sectors expand operations.

themes.title: Courts address AI hallucinations and fraud
themes.text: The Bombay High Court quashed a customs order that cited non-existent Supreme Court judgments, while the Madras High Court ordered an FIR over AI-generated and plagiarised books in public libraries.

stories.headline: Bombay High Court quashes customs order citing AI-hallucinated judgments
Madras High Court rules AI-generated books violate library rules, orders FIR

themes.title: NHA adopts EkaCare voice scribe
themes.text: The National Health Authority partnered with EkaCare to deploy an ambient AI Voice Scribe in public health facilities across more than 15 Indian languages.

stories.headline: NHA selects EkaCare for AI Voice Scribe in public health facilities

themes.title: AvenuesAI posts revenue surge
themes.text: Digital payments company AvenuesAI reported a 47 percent year-on-year rise in revenue to Rs 2,879.2 crore and a net profit of Rs 71.7 crore for the September quarter.

stories.headline: AvenuesAI reports Q2 net profit of Rs 72 cr and 47% revenue surge
